messages:
Ana (partnerships): quick sync: we're proposing a partner-focused compatibility sandbox + signed-package cutover for SDK adapters to support the new auth header and package signing. need cross-team alignment.
Grace (pm): high level ask: what are the actual breaking bits partners will hit? auth header? payload envelope? marketplace packaging?
Tom (eng): all three. breaking changes: 1) auth header moves from `X-API-Key` to `Authorization: Redwood <token>` with stricter token format, 2) envelope now requires `client_metadata` per request, 3) marketplace bundles must include a signed manifest v1.1.
Yuki (partner-eng): prioritize partners: cloud marketplace vendors + 5 SI gold partners + two HW integrators. they need test harness and badge indicating compatibility.
DevOps-bot: New sandbox cluster provisioned: https://ci.redwood.internal/sandboxes/partner-compat-2026 (ttl 14d)
Ana (partnerships): Proposal: phased plan
- Day 0: announce sandbox + compatibility matrix draft to partners
- Day 7: publish SDK adapters with shim layer (1 release) + signing tool (cli)
- Day 14: partner CI badge and marketplace manifest validation service live
- Day 30: 2-week opt-in window where partners can enable auto-upgrade in marketplace metadata
- Day 60: begin deprecation notices for old header/envelope
- Day 90: hard cut unless partner-specific exceptions approved
Grace (pm): sounds reasonable. Legal/Compliance: what do we need to include for signed manifests and key rotation?
Legal-bot: Please attach SOW addendum for partners who require dedicated key escrow. Also confirm the 60/90 timeline for contract amendments.
Tom (eng): Technical notes: shim will translate old header -> new format for 1 release, plus we will publish OpenAPI diff and example clients (python/node/go). Signing CLI: `rdw-sign manifest.json --key ~/.rdw/key.pem` produces `manifest.sig`.
Yuki (partner-eng): For hardware partners (edge boxes), we need offline signing guidance and update path for on-prem agents. propose OTA update window and fallback image containing old agent.
Ana (partnerships): Marketplace metadata fields to add: `supports_new_auth: true|false`, `signed_manifest_sha`, `auto_upgrade: opt-in|manual`, `cutover_date`. document these in the manifest spec.
DevOps-bot: Manifest validator v0.9 deployed to staging: https://tools.redwood.internal/manifest-validator (checks signing + schema)
Tom (eng): CI: add partner acceptance tests to our SDK repo under `tests/partners/<partner>` that can be run by partners in sandbox. Will provide a GitHub Actions template and a `.github/workflows/partner-ci.yml`.
Grace (pm): comms: prepare a marketplace banner, a partner advisory, and a small HOWTO video. Who can draft the partner advisory copy?
Ana (partnerships): I'll draft advisory + reach out to the top 15 partners for 1:1. Yuki can lead the SI outreach.
Yuki (partner-eng): I'll map the integration points for our top hardware and SI partners and label likely blockers (auth, streaming payloads, binary manifests).
Tom (eng): Rollout protections:
- telemetry: per-partner usage flags for old vs new auth (retain for 120d)
- canary routing: traffic split by partner header (10% -> new path)
- auto-rollback: if errors > 1.5% for 15m, revert traffic for that partner only.
Grace (pm): Need clear rollback comms if partner experiences failures during canary. Draft pre-approved rollback email templates?
Ana (partnerships): yes. I'll create 2 templates: urgent and non-urgent.
Yuki (partner-eng): Marketplace packaging: partners on AWS marketplace need specific bundle layout. I'll add an example in the sandbox and validate the publish pipeline.
Tom (eng): Security: key rotation plan: rotate signing key every 90 days, publish new public key in `/.well-known/rdw-keys.json`, support dual-accept for 7 days. We'll create an endpoint to fetch trust chain.
Legal-bot: Note: dual-accept windows must be included in partner agreements if automated upgrades are enabled.
DevOps-bot: Scheduled job: rotate-trust-keys at 1745640000 (cron)
Ana (partnerships): Action items: Ana: partner advisory + webinar; Grace: comms + video; Tom: shim + validator + example clients; Yuki: partner mapping + marketplace sample bundles; Legal-bot: prepare contract note. reconvene Tue 10am PT to review draft advisory.
Grace (pm): One more ask: compatibility badge levels: gold (fully signed + tests passing), silver (signed manifest, manual cutover), bronze (compat untested). Thoughts?
Yuki (partner-eng): good idea. badges will help marketplaces and SIs prioritize. I'll draft criteria.
Tom (eng): ETA on shim + validator PRs: two sprints. Example clients out in the next week for sandbox testing.
Ana (partnerships): OK team — I'll start outreach now. Please add any questions to the sandbox thread and tag me. Thanks :sparkles:
